sar_reference.narrative: On or about 2016-12-29, financial institution investigation identified unauthorized transactional activity impacting customer C08106 on payment card C08106-K1. Flagged transaction 3583227 totaling $128.33 was executed under patterns characteristic of PatternEnum.CARD_NOT_PRESENT_FRAUD. Graph traversal analysis identified connections across account profiles and device entities (DEV_1c36726b01402804), involving an aggregate suspicious exposure of $128.33. Cardholder inquiry verified the activity was unauthorized. The institution has blocked card C08106-K1, placed linked cards under protective monitoring, and submitted this Suspicious Activity Report pursuant to FinCEN guidelines and Bank Fraud Policy R2/R6.
